name: @kubbisec/mcp

tools.name: list_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Lists vulnerabilities (findings) for a KubbiSec project. Start with resolve_project_by_repository when you only have a Git URL, then call this with project_id or repository_url. Use source=KUBBISEC_AI after trigger_kubbisec_scan. Related: get_vulnerability, generate_remediation_plan.

project_id.description: Project ID when you already know it (snake_case; camelCase projectId also accepted).

repository_url.description: Git URL or org/repo; resolves project automatically (snake_case; repositoryUrl accepted).

repositoryUrl.description: Git URL or org/repo (camelCase alias of repository_url).

path.description: Monorepo path (for example /services/payments) used to disambiguate

source.description: Scan source filter (for example KUBBISEC_AI; snake_case scan_source and camelCase scanSource also accepted).

scan_source.description: Scan source filter (snake_case alias of source).

scanSource.description: Scan source filter (camelCase alias of source).

tools.name: get_vulnerability
tools.description: Gets full vulnerability details by ID. Use after list_vulnerabilities. Related: generate_remediation_plan, generate_issue_draft_for_vulnerability, start_ai_remediation_run.

tools.name: resolve_project_by_repository
tools.description: Resolves the KubbiSec project for a Git repository (confidence, match reason, candidates when ambiguous). Call first in findings/scan flows before list_vulnerabilities or trigger_kubbisec_scan. Pass path for monorepos.

repository_url.description: HTTPS/SSH URL, remote origin, or org/repo (snake_case).

path.description: Optional monorepo path used to disambiguate projects

branch.description: Context branch (metadata only; the API does not filter by branch yet)

tools.name: list_project_by_repository_candidates
tools.description: Lists project candidates for a repository when resolve_project_by_repository is ambiguous. Same inputs as resolve_project_by_repository.

repository_url.description: HTTPS/SSH URL, remote origin, or org/repo (snake_case).

path.description: Optional monorepo path used to disambiguate projects

branch.description: Context branch (metadata only; the API does not filter by branch yet)

tools.name: trigger_kubbisec_scan
tools.description: Enqueues a hybrid local scan (requires kubbisec watch on a machine with the repo). Call resolve_project_by_repository first if needed. Poll with get_kubbisec_scan_status; filter findings with list_vulnerabilities source=KUBBISEC_AI.

repository_url.description: Git URL or org/repo; resolves project automatically (snake_case; repositoryUrl accepted).

repositoryUrl.description: Git URL or org/repo (camelCase alias of repository_url).

path.description: Monorepo path (for example /services/payments) used to disambiguate

requireScanners.description: Require local scanners (camelCase alias of require_scanners).

tools.name: get_kubbisec_scan_status
tools.description: Polls scan task status by task_id until done, failed, or cancelled. Use after trigger_kubbisec_scan.

task_id.description: Scan task ID (snake_case; taskId also accepted).

taskId.description: Scan task ID (camelCase alias of task_id).

tools.name: list_kubbisec_scan_tasks
tools.description: Lists scan tasks for a project (optional status filter). Use to inspect pending hybrid scans.

project_id.description: Filter by project ID (snake_case; projectId accepted).

repository_url.description: Resolve project and filter tasks (snake_case; repositoryUrl accepted).

path.description: Monorepo path used to disambiguate repository resolution

status.description: Filter by task status (for example pending, done).

tools.name: cancel_kubbisec_scan_task
tools.description: Cancels a pending scan task. Use when a queued hybrid scan should not run.

task_id.description: Scan task ID to cancel (snake_case; taskId accepted).

taskId.description: Scan task ID to cancel (camelCase alias).

tools.name: generate_remediation_plan
tools.description: Generates an AI remediation plan (Markdown + structured steps) for a vulnerability. Call after get_vulnerability. Optional next step: start_ai_remediation_run.

tools.name: generate_issue_draft_for_vulnerability
tools.description: Generates a reviewable issue draft for a vulnerability without creating an external ticket. Use before filing Jira/GitHub issues manually.

tools.name: start_ai_remediation_run
tools.description: Starts automated AI remediation for a vulnerability (suggestion mode). Poll with get_ai_remediation_run_status and get_ai_remediation_run_logs. Requires kubbisec watch on a developer machine.

mode.description: Remediation mode (only 'suggestion' is available; 'auto' is blocked by guardrail)

tools.name: get_ai_remediation_run_status
tools.description: Gets status of an AI remediation run by run_id. Use after start_ai_remediation_run.

tools.name: get_ai_remediation_run_logs
tools.description: Gets aggregated logs for an AI remediation run by run_id. Use when debugging failed remediation.

tools.name: validate_naus_pipeline_yaml
tools.description: Validates Naus pipeline YAML with @kubbisec/naus-validation (same rules as the KubbiSec editor). HARD-GATE: do not propose YAML unless ok is true in diagnostics.

yaml.description: Full Naus pipeline YAML to validate.

tools.name: list_pipeline_generation_jobs
tools.description: Lists CI pipeline generation jobs (AI/template batch from bulk GitHub import). Provide batchId or projectId.

projectId.description: Filter jobs for a single project.

instructions:
<kubbisec-mcp-instructions>
<kubbisec-product-knowledge>
  <products>
    <product id="naus" npm="@kubbisec/naus" bin="naus">KubbiSec CI engine: .naus.yml pipelines, runners, validate/plan/run. Cloud CI uses Env Packs; local run uses --env-file / --secret-file.</product>
    <product id="aspm" npm="@kubbisec/aspm" bin="aspm">Security CLI: parse/upload scanner reports (trivy, gitleaks, syft, osv, semgrep, sonar, nmap, skipfish), coverage, gate.</product>
    <product id="ai" npm="@kubbisec/ai" bin="kubbisec">CLI hub: login, findings (ls/show), fix/watch/chat, optional naus/aspm forwarding when binaries are on PATH.</product>
  </products>
  <boundaries>
    <boundary>NAUS YAML is NOT GitHub Actions: top-level run: (never jobs:); script: + depends_on: (never commands:/needs:/steps:); ASPM jobs use kind: aspm|aspm_matrix|aspm_gate with tool: (never scanner:).</boundary>
    <boundary>aspm-cicd.md / aspm_docs section aspm-cicd describe GitHub Actions only. For KubbiSec native CI use naus_pipeline_docs (naus-aspm-integration, naus-aspm-preset, naus-aspm-matrix, naus-aspm-gate).</boundary>
    <boundary>Do not mix CLIs: naus for pipelines/runners; aspm for scan upload/parse; kubbisec for AI remediation/chat. Org flag -o uses organization slug.</boundary>
  </boundaries>
  <anti-hallucination>
    <rule>HARD-GATE: never invent CLI flags or full command lines — call naus_pipeline_docs (naus-commands), aspm_docs (aspm-commands), ai_docs (ai-commands), or security_scanner_playbook first.</rule>
    <rule>HARD-GATE: never output fenced NAUS pipeline YAML unless naus_validate_yaml (or naus_local_validate) returned ok in this session.</rule>
    <rule>HARD-GATE: never claim a tool/action succeeded without a successful tool_result in this turn.</rule>
  </anti-hallucination>
  <tool-routing>
    <route intent="platform-knowledge">kubbisec_mcp_knowledge (start of naus/aspm/ai product questions)</route>
    <route intent="naus-docs-yaml">naus_pipeline_docs → naus_schema_overview → validate_naus_pipeline_yaml</route>
    <route intent="aspm-docs">aspm_docs; scanners: security_scanners_catalog → security_scanner_playbook</route>
    <route intent="ai-cli-docs">ai_docs (ai-commands, ai-watch, mcp-login, scan, scan-watch)</route>
    <route intent="local-clis">naus_local_* / aspm_local_* / github_local_* always available in chat (no --extended-context); github uses host-first auth; missing naus/aspm auto-install @kubbisec/naus|aspm</route>
  </tool-routing>
</kubbisec-product-knowledge>

<flows>
  <flow id="findings">Recommended flow: use resolve_project_by_repository with repository_url or repositoryUrl (Git URL or org/repo), then list_vulnerabilities with the same repository fields or project_id/projectId. Tools accept snake_case and camelCase interchangeably. To act on a finding, use get_vulnerability (MCP) or get_finding_summary / list_findings (assistant CLI), then generate_remediation_plan and, if you want automation, start_ai_remediation_run followed by get_ai_remediation_run_status/get_ai_remediation_run_logs (run_id or runId). Pass vulnerabilityId (or vulnerability_id) in tool arguments when using kbs chat — there is no separate set_active_finding tool.</flow>
  <flow id="naus-cloud">Naus CI YAML in MCP: call validate_naus_pipeline_yaml before proposing or persisting YAML. Pipeline IDE flows (set_editor_yaml, trigger_run) are Platform Assistant only.</flow>
  <flow id="naus-aspm-local">Naus / ASPM / git on the developer machine (kbs or kubbisec chat; no --extended-context required): naus_local_validate | naus_local_plan | naus_local_run; aspm_local_scan | aspm_local_upload | aspm_local_doctor; github_local_* uses host-first gh/git auth (platform token only as remediation fallback). Missing naus/aspm binaries auto-install @kubbisec/naus and @kubbisec/aspm globally via npm/pnpm (allowlist). Local naus run/plan: default .secrets and .env in cwd, or --env-file / --secret-file; naus_local_run and naus_local_plan accept envFiles/secretFiles arrays. Cloud runners use Env Packs instead. Runner enrollment: naus register / naus start — do not spawn long-lived daemons from MCP chat.</flow>
  <flow id="kubbisec-scan">Hybrid local scan: MCP cannot run Pi/Superpowers on the host. (1) resolve_project_by_repository with repository_url or repositoryUrl (Git URL or org/repo), or project_id/projectId. (2) trigger_kubbisec_scan with profile quick|full|ci (default full), upload (default true), require_scanners/requireScanners optional. (3) get_kubbisec_scan_status with task_id/taskId until status is done, failed, or cancelled; list_kubbisec_scan_tasks or cancel_kubbisec_scan_task as needed. Requires kubbisec watch or kubbisec scan --watch on a developer machine with repo checkout — task stays pending until claimed. Findings upload with source=KUBBISEC_AI; filter via list_vulnerabilities source=KUBBISEC_AI. For immediate local scan without queue, user runs kubbisec scan in terminal (not an MCP tool).</flow>
</flows>

<intent-matrix>
| Intent | Cloud (API/MCP) | Local (host CLI) |
| Validate YAML | validate_naus_pipeline_yaml | naus_local_validate |
| Run pipeline | trigger_run (assistant) | naus_local_run |
| Dependency graph | — | naus_local_plan |
| Upload scan report | CI / findings API | aspm_local_upload |
| ASPM CLI health | — | aspm_local_doctor |
| Hybrid AI scan | trigger_kubbisec_scan | kubbisec scan |
| Scan status | get_kubbisec_scan_status | stdout / .kubbisec/scan/<runId>/ |
| Filter AI findings | list_vulnerabilities + source=KUBBISEC_AI | — |
| MCP auth | hosted OAuth / device login | kubbisec mcp login |
| Product docs | Platform Assistant / kubbisec chat | — |
</intent-matrix>

<rules>
  <rule id="superpowers-mcp">MCP agents must NOT invoke Pi/Superpowers skills or spawn kubbisec chat for scan orchestration. MCP has no documentation tools — use validate_naus_pipeline_yaml for YAML. Scan = trigger_kubbisec_scan; remediation = start_ai_remediation_run.</rule>
  <rule id="hosted-mcp">Hosted MCP endpoint: https://mcp.kubbisec.com/mcp (OAuth2 for cloud IDEs). Local stdio: set KUBBISEC_ORGANIZATION_SLUG (preferred, e.g. minha-empresa) and KUBBISEC_API_KEY, or run kubbisec mcp login for device flow. Legacy KUBBISEC_ORGANIZATION_ID remains supported.</rule>
</rules>
</kubbisec-mcp-instructions>
